A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Always Skip Attention and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–C. Content can be matched reliably across the revised layout and figure numbering.

before.justification: V2 reports original skip-connection experiments, supervised and self-supervised classification results, conditioning analyses, and appendix Jacobian spectra.

after.justification: V3 retains original classification experiments, token-graying evaluations, skip-connection analyses, and Jacobian-spectrum results in Appendix C.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1 and 2 retain the same SVD and DCT token-graying procedures, including normalization, amplification, reconstruction, and patch embedding. Model components and training objectives are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, and ImageNet-1K for the same tasks. V3 mentions robotic applications in the introduction but reports no additional evaluation domain or test scenario.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain the same methods: linear and softmax attention, SVDTG and DCTTG, the ViT/Swin/CaiT/PVT variants, and MAE. Newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Reported evaluation settings remain unchanged, including the 10% validation subset for layer-conditioning plots, default amplification coefficient, model configurations, and MAE pretraining and fine-tuning schedules. The corrected Tiny-ImageNet citation does not indicate a dataset or protocol change.

E4.justification: Both retain the SAB-versus-FFN skip ablations, ConvMixer comparison, amplification sweeps, conditioning trajectories, and appendix Jacobian analyses. V2 Figure 2 becomes v3 Figure 6 in Appendix B; the analysis is preserved.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. V3's added ±0.2% ConvMixer statement describes differences between configurations, not statistical uncertainty.

E6.justification: V3's introduction explicitly quantifies ConvMixer accuracy variations as less than ±0.2%, adding numerical detail to v2's qualitative description. Tables 1–5 and the matched plots otherwise retain their values and findings; this is additional reporting, not a demonstrated performance gain.

T1.justification: The introductory assumptions, Propositions 4.1 and 4.2, their proofs in Appendix A, and the ConvMixer derivation in Appendix B are unchanged. No mathematical correction or additional theoretical result is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same central claims about self-attention conditioning, the role of skip connections, and token graying. The emphasis on conditioning insight as the central contribution is preserved.

C2.justification: The introduction changes better embedding conditioning 'leads to' improved performance to 'consistently correlates with' improved performance, modestly qualifying the causal interpretation. Mechanism explanations and the limitations concerning low precision and marginal gains remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The same pseudocode, PyTorch/Timm disclosure, model dimensions, hyperparameters, training schedules, and computational-complexity information are provided. V3 adds no technical implementation detail or code/data access instructions.

R1.justification: V3 adds citations concerning conditioning, optimization, self-supervised pretraining, and robotic vision, including RandLoRA and Pair-VPR. It replaces the Tiny-ImageNet citation to How to Train Your ViT? with Le and Yang's dataset reference. The substantive novelty positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: V3 edits introductory paragraphs and several explanatory passages, updates title capitalization and affiliations, and adds contact details and acknowledgements. The section structure is retained. Some editing introduces defects, including a duplicated clause in the related-work discussion.

P2.justification: V3 reformats the front matter and Figure 1, changes the assumptions-box styling, and moves the ConvMixer plot into Appendix B. Other displays are relocated or renumbered, and table percentage formatting is standardized. The visual evidence remains substantively unchanged.

improvement.justification: V3 modestly improves precision and sourcing by replacing causal wording with correlational wording and correcting the Tiny-ImageNet reference in Section 6.1. These limited gains outweigh small editorial defects, including the newly duplicated related-work clause. The unchanged experiments and proofs provide no substantial strengthening of the paper's validation.
